mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( users_id, board_title, board_content, board_image, board_date, board_viewcount ) VALUES ( #{usersId}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{boardImage}, CURDATE(), 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT b.board_id, b.users_id, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_viewcount, b.board_image, b.board_date, b.board_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.board_id = b.board_id) AS comment_count,
u.users_nickname AS board_wirter, -- 작성자 닉네임 u.users_profile AS board_writer_image -- 작성자 프로필 FROM board b JOIN users u ON b.users_id = u.users_id ORDER BY b.board_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.board_id, b.users_id, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_image, b.board_date, b.board_viewcount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.board_id = b.board_id) AS comment_count, -- ← 쉼표 추가 u.users_nickname AS board_wirter, -- 작성자 닉네임 u.users_profile AS board_writer_image -- 작성자 프로필 FROM board b JOIN users u ON b.users_id = u.users_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET board_title = #{boardTitle}, board_content = #{boardContent}, board_image = #{boardImage}, board_date = CURDATE() WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND users_id = #{usersId}
